title: Viyabari
desc: A zealous entrepreneur clones himself to balance his work and family life. However, after a tragic mishap, he realizes the unforeseen consequences of his actions.

title: Ponniyin Selvan 2
desc: Prince Aditha Karikalan attempts to tackle the attacks of Pandyas, Rashtrakutas and other enemies on the Chola dynasty in the wake of the presumed death of his brother Ponniyin Selvan.

title: Sandakozhi
desc: Balu, on a visit to his friend's hometown, falls for the latter's sister, Hema. However, when he learns that the area is ruled by a local gangster, Kasi, Balu teaches him a lesson.

title: Devarattam
desc: Vetri, a young lawyer with anger issues, murders his friend, who also happens to be the son of a local gangster, in broad daylight. Later, the gangster seeks to kill Vetri.

title: Endhiran
desc: When a lovelorn humanoid ends up in the wrong hands and goes on a rampage across the city, a scientist must do whatever it takes to restore peace and order.
